questions.question: What is SRE?
questions.ideal_answer: Engineering discipline focused on reliability and scalability.

questions.question: What is Uptime?
questions.ideal_answer: Percentage of time a system remains operational.

questions.question: What is Observability?
questions.ideal_answer: Ability to understand internal system state.

questions.question: SLA vs SLO?
questions.ideal_answer: SLA is agreement, SLO is reliability target.

questions.question: Handle Outages.
questions.ideal_answer: Identify root cause and restore service.
